Turn a DE result object into a plain data frame

Source: R/de_objects.R
de_table.Rd

Converts the result objects returned by the three major differential expression pipelines into a plain data.frame that ggvolc and genes_table understand. You rarely need to call this yourself: both functions call it internally, so you can pass the objects straight in. It is exported for when you want to inspect or filter the table first.

Usage

de_table(x, coef = NULL)

Arguments

x

A DE result object or a data frame (see Details).

coef

For a multi-coefficient limma fit, the coefficient (name or index) to extract. For a DESeqDataSet, passed as name to DESeq2::results(). Ignored otherwise.

Value

A data.frame with one row per gene. Gene identifiers are kept in the row names (or a genes column, if the input had one).

Details

Supported inputs:

DESeq2

A DESeqResults object from DESeq2::results() or DESeq2::lfcShrink(), or a DESeqDataSet after DESeq2::DESeq(), in which case DESeq2::results() is called for you (with name = coef when coef is given).

edgeR

A TopTags object from edgeR::topTags(), or a DGELRT / DGEExact object from edgeR::glmQLFTest(), edgeR::glmLRT() or edgeR::exactTest(). All genes are kept (edgeR::topTags(x, n = Inf)).

limma

An MArrayLM fit after limma::eBayes(). limma::topTable(fit, coef = coef, number = Inf) is called for you. If the fit has more than one coefficient, coef is required.

data frame

Any data.frame (including tibbles) is returned unchanged.

Examples

# A data frame passes straight through
head(de_table(all_genes))
#>       genes   baseMean log2FoldChange     lfcSE       stat       pvalue
#> 1      GCR1  7201.5782       2.244064 0.2004959  11.192564 4.434241e-29
#> 2     OPI10  1009.4171      -2.257454 0.2096469 -10.767889 4.880607e-27
#> 3      AGA2   249.1173       3.829474 0.3623263  10.569132 4.143136e-26
#> 4 FIM1_1376  5237.5035       2.550409 0.2560379   9.961059 2.256459e-23
#> 5      HMG1 10838.1037       2.214300 0.2229065   9.933763 2.968371e-23
#> 6 FIM1_3918  2456.8070       2.288243 0.2356228   9.711467 2.694309e-22
#>           padj
#> 1 2.153711e-25
#> 2 1.185255e-23
#> 3 6.707736e-23
#> 4 2.739905e-20
#> 5 2.883475e-20
#> 6 2.181043e-19

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# DESeq2
dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds)
ggvolc(DESeq2::results(dds))       # results object
ggvolc(dds)                        # or the dataset itself

# edgeR
fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design)
ggvolc(edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2))

# limma
fit <- limma::eBayes(limma::lmFit(v, design))
ggvolc(fit, coef = "treatment")
} # }
